prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
engine_stated_criteria: best AI video ad maker depends on your use case
Creatify is the best default pick for most marketers
answer_verbatim:
The **best AI video ad maker depends on your use case**, but the most consistently recommended *overall* picks in the results are **Creatify**, **HeyGen**, and **Revid.ai**.[1][2][14][19]

- **Creatify** is the strongest all-around choice for **ecommerce and performance ads**; multiple sources call it the best overall for creating high-quality video ads and variations quickly.[1][6][12][14]
- **HeyGen** is the best fit if you want **avatar-driven ads** or **multilingual ads**; its own testing highlights avatar quality and support for **175+ languages**.[2][15]
- **Revid.ai** is the best fit for **short-form paid social workflows** and all-in-one ad editing, especially if you want hooks, captions, product-page videos, and automation in one tool.[19]

If you want a single practical recommendation: **Creatify is the best default pick for most marketers**, while **HeyGen** is better for talking-head/avatar ads and **Revid.ai** is better for short-form social ad production.[1][2][19]
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
